name: aadhaar-input
title: Aadhaar Input
description: Prevents rejected KYC and over-exposed Aadhaar numbers by masking the entry as XXXX XXXX 1234 while typing (reveal on demand), checking the Verhoeff digit and the never-0-or-1 first digit, offering a one-tap reveal when the check digit fails (instead of guessing a swap that is often wrong), recognising a VID, the 28-digit enrolment ID, a masked copy, a PAN or a mobile number (with or without +91) pasted by mistake, cleaning photocopy spaces and dashes, and saying that a VID or masked number is enough and how the number is stored.
